data.title: Scoop
data.summary: Curettes & extractors · Double-ended instrument with shallow oval spoons, used to scoop out cavity contents and granulation tissue.
data.body:
![Scoop](instruments/scoop.jpg)

_Also called: Volkmann double-ended scoop, Volkmann spoon_

Double-ended instrument with shallow oval spoons, used to scoop out cavity contents and granulation tissue.

## Parts
- Central handle
- Oval, spoon-shaped shallow pointed expansion at either end
- Spoon edges sharp (PPT1)

## Types / variants
- Small, medium and large sizes; small to medium most used

## Uses / indications
- Scooping out contents of cysts, abscesses and ulcers
- Removal of hyperplastic granulation tissue around an ingrown toenail
- Ulcer debridement, corn enucleation (seminar)
- Nail surgery; applying cell pellet in cell-based vitiligo surgery (PPT1)

## How to hold
Pencil (fountain-pen) grip between thumb, index and middle finger, or potato-peeler grip with the handle in the distal interdigital fold of the index finger and thumb as a stable base; stretch the skin with the other hand.

## Sterilisation & care
Autoclave, hot air oven, 2% glutaraldehyde or boiling

## Viva points & tips
- Larger and deeper than a molluscum curette
- Considered a modification of the curette (PPT1)
